title: storyboard.create_storyboard_panel_version input
description: Appends a panel version for one storyboard item. It records what a panel should show; it does not generate an image, which is a Job rather than an agent's tool.

itemId.description: The storyboard item this panel belongs to.

prompt.description: What the panel depicts, as a generation prompt.

negativePrompt.description: What the panel must not contain.

basedOnVersionId.description: The panel version this one revises, or empty for the first.

changeReason.description: Why this version exists, in one sentence.
